name: selfBox
meaning: scanner's first model box translated to its position (Box_Translate, ecx = scratch at 0x492567)

name: candBox
meaning: candidate box translated to the candidate's position (ecx = scratch+0x10 at 0x4927bc)

name: primaryBoxGap
meaning: box-gap threshold, starts at boxDist, lowered by an accepted primary box (0x492992); gates both outputs (0x49280f)

name: primaryPointDist2
meaning: squared point radius, starts at pointRadius^2, lowered by an accepted primary point (0x492a8f); gates both outputs (0x492a41)

name: secondaryBoxGap
meaning: written on an accepted secondary box (0x4929da); never read by the scanner

name: secondaryPointDist2
meaning: written on an accepted secondary point (0x492ade); never read by the scanner
